meta.name: posthumous-title-abolition
meta.description: Use when abolishing the posthumous title system (谥法) to prevent subjects from judging rulers. Establishes sequential numbering from 始皇帝 onward as an alternative naming convention. Abolished by Qin Shi Huang in 221 BCE.

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果研究中国古代政治制度或秦朝历史
copy.tagline_en: Abolish the posthumous title system, adopt sequential numbering
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study ancient Chinese political systems or Qin dynasty history

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会执行废除谥号的流程：发布诏书禁止臣子评判君主，改用“始皇帝、二世皇帝”等数字编号命名后代皇帝。
howto.when: 当你希望废除谥号制度，防止臣子评判君主时触发。

say.text: 请发布废除谥号的诏书。
建立从始皇帝开始的数字编号规则。
say.note: Claude 会设定替代命名方式。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude will execute the procedure to abolish posthumous titles: issue an imperial decree banning subjects from judging rulers, and establish sequential numbering (e.g., First Emperor, Second Emperor) for naming future emperors.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to abolish the posthumous title system to prevent subjects from judging rulers.

say_en.text: Issue the imperial decree to abolish posthumous titles.
say_en.note: Claude will execute the abolition steps.

say_en.text: Establish sequential numbering starting from First Emperor.
say_en.note: Claude will set the alternative naming convention.
